Implement the business model.

Product rules

Every new visitor is entitled to one free successful reading.

A successful reading means audio generation completed and playback was made available to the user.

Failed OCR or failed audio generation must not consume the free reading.

After the free reading is consumed, further audio generation requires an active subscription.
